subtitle: 先学会做人，再谈独立。

oneLineCore.zh: 先照顾家庭关系，再谈个人独立。
oneLineCore.en: Family ties often come before talking about independence.

memoryPoints.zh: 孝道是家庭秩序，不只是感情。
memoryPoints.en: Filial piety is family order, not only feeling.

memoryPoints.zh: 小事里可见：先让长辈动筷。
memoryPoints.en: It shows in small acts: elders start the meal.

memoryPoints.zh: 年轻一代更要空间，两代容易吵。
memoryPoints.en: Younger people want space, so generations clash.

memoryPoints.zh: 尊重不等于什么都听父母的。
memoryPoints.en: Respect is not the same as obeying everything.

memoryPoints.zh: 身份在关系网里：你是谁的孩子。

subtitle: 有面子，没面子，丢面子，爱面子。

oneLineCore.zh: 面子是别人眼中的体面。
oneLineCore.en: Face is dignity as other people see it.

memoryPoints.zh: 请客、成绩、学校都可能关乎面子。

memoryPoints.zh: 谦虚常用来挡住过于张扬。
memoryPoints.en: Modesty often blocks being too high-profile.

memoryPoints.zh: 劝酒有时是热情，有时是权力测试。
memoryPoints.en: A toast can be warmth, or a test of power.

memoryPoints.zh: 拒绝要给人台阶，不只硬说不。
memoryPoints.en: A refusal should leave a way out, not only a no.

memoryPoints.zh: 爱面子能护荣誉，也能变成虚荣。

oneLineCore.en: The self is often confirmed through a group.

memoryPoints.en: Uniforms and class songs train belonging.

memoryPoints.zh: 好处是互助；代价是异议像不合群。

memoryPoints.zh: 城市年轻人同时追求个性和合群。

memoryPoints.zh: 两种过年都在问：家在哪里？

memoryPoints.zh: 对应物：任何「一年必须回家一次」的节日。

oneLineCore.en: Paper, type, fire and the needle change how people meet.

memoryPoints.zh: 造纸让陌生人能读同一份文字。
memoryPoints.en: Paper lets strangers read the same text.

memoryPoints.zh: 印刷让一句话活过说它的人。
memoryPoints.en: Print lets a sentence outlive the person who spoke it.

memoryPoints.zh: 火药可写成节日，也可写成爆破。
memoryPoints.en: Gunpowder can be written as a festival, or as blasting.

memoryPoints.zh: 指南针压缩海里的未知；今天变成手机里的箭头。
memoryPoints.en: The compass shrank the unknown sea; today it is an arrow in a phone.

memoryPoints.zh: 下一件「四大」，要问它改了关系还是只改了方便。
memoryPoints.en: The next “four” should be tested on relations, not only convenience.

imageEvidence.zh: 一垛线装旧书叠在左手边，书口发黄。

imageEvidence.zh: 墙上或架上挂着书法立轴，墨色比桌上的纸更深。
imageEvidence.en: A calligraphy scroll hangs on the wall or shelf; its ink is darker than the paper on the desk.

imageEvidence.zh: 砚台里有一汪墨，墨条搁在旁边。
imageEvidence.en: A pool of ink in the inkstone, an ink stick laid beside it.

essentialLanguage.collocationEn: The compass is an invention that changed seafaring.

essentialLanguage.collocation: 造纸术让书写变得便宜。
essentialLanguage.collocationEn: Papermaking made writing cheaper.

essentialLanguage.collocation: 印刷让知识传播得更快。
essentialLanguage.collocationEn: Printing let knowledge travel faster.

essentialLanguage.collocation: 火药既用于战争，也用于烟花。
essentialLanguage.collocationEn: Gunpowder is used in war and in fireworks.

essentialLanguage.collocation: 水手靠指南针辨别方向。
essentialLanguage.collocationEn: Sailors used the compass to find direction.

expressionCaution.en: Do not say Europe had no counterparts in paper and print.

compareAnchor.zh: 西班牙也有对应物

oneLineCore.en: Characters can be taken apart; different accents can still read together.

memoryPoints.zh: 笔画和偏旁是记忆的骨架。
memoryPoints.en: Strokes and radicals are a skeleton for memory.

memoryPoints.zh: 繁简并存：招牌求古，菜单求快。
memoryPoints.en: Traditional and simplified coexist: signs look old, menus look fast.

memoryPoints.zh: 输入法把一句话缩成一秒，手却更少落在纸上。
memoryPoints.en: Input methods shrink a sentence to a second; hands meet paper less.

memoryPoints.zh: 能写的机器，不等于你会认。
memoryPoints.en: A machine that can write is not the same as you being able to recognise.

memoryPoints.zh: 当场拆一个字，比只说「汉字很美」更有分。
memoryPoints.en: Taking one character apart scores higher than calling characters beautiful.

imageEvidence.zh: 镜头贴得很近，纸的纤维一根一根看得见。
imageEvidence.en: The lens is very close: the fibres of the paper can be seen one by one.

imageEvidence.zh: 墨还湿，边缘有润开，说明字刚写下不久。
imageEvidence.en: The ink is still wet, bleeding at the edges, so the character was written only a moment ago.

imageEvidence.zh: 笔画是中锋走出来的，有粗有细，不是打印体。
imageEvidence.en: The strokes were made with a centred brush, thick and thin — not a printed font.

imageEvidence.zh: 某处有飞白或枯笔，手的速度被留在纸上。
imageEvidence.en: Somewhere there is flying white or a dry brush: the speed of the hand is left on the paper.

essentialLanguage.collocationEn: Every character has its own story.

essentialLanguage.collocation: 这个字有十二画。

essentialLanguage.collocation: 识字率的提高改变了社会。
essentialLanguage.collocationEn: Higher literacy changed society.

oneLineCore.en: A craft is learned by years; a flourish can travel in seconds.

memoryPoints.zh: 京剧脸谱把角色写成可阅读的颜色。
memoryPoints.en: Opera face-paint writes a role in readable colour.

memoryPoints.zh: 书法、瓷器、剪纸都靠师徒和重复的手。
memoryPoints.en: Calligraphy, porcelain and paper-cut rely on master, apprentice and repetition.

memoryPoints.zh: 短视频能当门口，不能当全部的屋子。

memoryPoints.zh: 对应物：弗拉门戈也靠年岁和身体。

memoryPoints.zh: 改变呈现可以，前提是还说得出材料和步骤。
memoryPoints.en: Form may change if you can still name material and the first step.

memoryPoints.zh: 方便的门票，常常是被记住每一次购买。
memoryPoints.en: The ticket for convenience is often being remembered on every purchase.

memoryPoints.en: For elders, visitors and outages, cash still works.

memoryPoints.zh: 信任靠语气和倒计时，退货路径要能说清。
memoryPoints.en: Trust rides on tone and countdown; returns must still be explainable.

memoryPoints.zh: 实体店剩下镜头给不了的：摸、量、等。
memoryPoints.en: A shop keeps what a lens cannot give: touch, measure, wait.

subtitle: 土地被压缩，有人被连上，有人被路过。

oneLineCore.en: High-speed rail compresses land; some are connected, some are passed.

memoryPoints.zh: 准点和高架桥把旅行变成可计算的时间。
memoryPoints.en: Punctuality and viaducts make travel into countable time.

memoryPoints.zh: 身体感受：加速、声音、窗外的尺度变小。

memoryPoints.en: A counterpart: Spain’s AVE also shrinks distance, on a thinner net.

memoryPoints.zh: 先连大城市更有效率，偏远地区可能被路过。
memoryPoints.en: Linking big cities is efficient; remote places may be skipped.

memoryPoints.zh: 基建的问题不只是快，是谁先被连上。
memoryPoints.en: Infrastructure is not only speed; it is who is linked first.

memoryPoints.en: If “dragon” means stability and health, the timetable changes.

imageEvidence.en: The openings differ — round, square, some locked — telling the hand not to flip a lid at random.

imageEvidence.zh: 画面里几乎没有正在扔垃圾的人——规则留在路上，人已经走开。

essentialLanguage.collocationEn: Cartons are recyclable; tear the tape off if you can.

oneLineCore.en: Solar terms are a poem of farm time, and a climate reminder.

memoryPoints.zh: 二十四节气按太阳走，不是按生日蛋糕走。
memoryPoints.en: The twenty-four terms follow the sun, not birthday cakes.

memoryPoints.zh: 春分、芒种、冬至，把天气写成可做的事。
memoryPoints.en: Spring Equinox, Grain in Ear, Winter Solstice turn weather into tasks.

memoryPoints.zh: 梯田里有的田有水、有的是土，同一天农事不同。
memoryPoints.en: On one day some terraces hold water, some earth: work differs.

memoryPoints.zh: 城市人不必装农民，仍可用它校对身体和季节。
memoryPoints.en: City people need not play farmer, yet can still check body and season.

memoryPoints.zh: 气候一变，传统农时就会和真实天气错位。
memoryPoints.en: When climate shifts, traditional farm time slips from real weather.

imageEvidence.zh: 梯田一层一层，田埂是曲线，不是旅游的几何图案，是工作的台阶。
imageEvidence.en: Terraces layer on layer; the ridges are curves, not a tourist geometry — they are working steps.

imageEvidence.zh: 水面反光，有的田有水、有的田是土，说明同一天里农活不同。
imageEvidence.en: Water throws light: some fields are wet, some earth — the same day holds different work.

imageEvidence.zh: 远山把地平线压低，人的尺度在田里，不在天上。
imageEvidence.en: Far hills press the horizon down; the human scale is in the field, not in the sky.

imageEvidence.zh: 日出或晨雾：这是下地的时间，不是明信片的滤镜。
imageEvidence.en: Sunrise or morning mist: this is the hour for going down to the field, not a postcard filter.

essentialLanguage.collocation: 节气是联合国非遗，也是农时。
essentialLanguage.collocationEn: The solar terms are UNESCO heritage, and also farm time.

essentialLanguage.collocation: 年节跟农历，节气更跟太阳。
essentialLanguage.collocationEn: Festivals follow the lunar calendar; the terms follow the sun more.

essentialLanguage.collocation: 春分昼夜差不多长。
essentialLanguage.collocationEn: At the Spring Equinox day and night are almost equal.

essentialLanguage.collocation: 冬至白天最短，北方吃饺子。
essentialLanguage.collocationEn: Dongzhi is the shortest day; the north eats dumplings.

essentialLanguage.collocation: 芒种要抢收抢种。
essentialLanguage.collocationEn: Grain in Ear is a race to harvest and sow.

expressionCaution.zh: 不要把节气说成每个城市上班族都在下地。
expressionCaution.en: Do not say every city office worker still goes down to the fields.

compareAnchor.zh: 地中海饮食也是联合国非遗
compareAnchor.en: The Mediterranean diet is also UNESCO heritage: not the honour of one dish, but binding people and land to one table by season, nearness, vegetables and olive oil.

subtitle: 镜头对着菜垄时，村子仍要学校和诊所。
ibLens: Sharing the planet · Urban & rural / ethics

oneLineCore.zh: 镜头对着菜垄时，村子仍要学校和诊所。
oneLineCore.en: When the lens faces the rows, the village still needs a school and a clinic.

memoryPoints.zh: 助农拍摄把地里的菜变成可下单的画面。
memoryPoints.en: Farm-aid filming turns rows of vegetables into something to order.

memoryPoints.zh: 年轻人离开，常因学校、诊所、收入和对象。
memoryPoints.en: Young people leave for school, clinic, income and a partner — not only nightlife.

memoryPoints.zh: 旅游能带钱，也可能改村子的性格。
memoryPoints.en: Tourism can bring money, and can change a village’s character.

memoryPoints.zh: 空心化是结构：住的人少，公共服务更难维持。
memoryPoints.en: Hollowing-out is structure: fewer residents, harder services.

memoryPoints.zh: 包裹进出变多，不等于村里的人更有选择。
memoryPoints.en: More parcels in and out does not mean villagers have more choice.

imageEvidence.zh: 一个人举着手机或云台
imageEvidence.en: Someone holds a phone or gimbal; the lens faces the vegetable rows, not their own face. In this picture, at least, the goods come first.

imageEvidence.zh: 绿叶菜一行行，泥土还在，说明直播的对象首先是地里的东西。
imageEvidence.en: Rows of greens, soil still there: what the livestream first sells is what is in the ground.

imageEvidence.zh: 山在后面，村子的尺度是山给的，不是商场给的。
imageEvidence.en: Hills behind: the village’s scale is given by the mountain, not by a mall.

imageEvidence.zh: 瓦房或小楼在田边，住和种仍贴在一起。
imageEvidence.en: Tile houses or small blocks sit by the field; living and planting still stick together.

essentialLanguage.collocation: 乡村不能只当城市的食堂。
essentialLanguage.collocationEn: The countryside cannot only be the city’s canteen.

essentialLanguage.collocation: 振兴要看谁留下，不看墙绘。
essentialLanguage.collocationEn: Revitalization is who stays, not the mural.

essentialLanguage.collocation: 扶贫之后仍要问孩子在哪上学。
essentialLanguage.collocationEn: After poverty relief, still ask where the child goes to school.

essentialLanguage.collocation: 物流到村不等于共同富裕。
essentialLanguage.collocationEn: Logistics to the village is not the same as common prosperity.

essentialLanguage.collocation: 留守是机会不在土地上的结果。
essentialLanguage.collocationEn: Left-behind is what happens when chance is not on the land.

expressionCaution.zh: 不要把乡村振兴的宣传片写成已经完成的事实。
expressionCaution.en: Do not write a revitalization film as an already finished fact.

compareAnchor.zh: 西班牙人用 España vaciada 称呼内陆被掏空的省：学校并掉、医生巡回、年轻人去马德里和海岸
compareAnchor.en: Spaniards call the emptied inland provinces España vaciada: schools merged, doctors on circuit, the young gone to Madrid and the coast.

subtitle: 冲突常在租金和能源，不一定在瓦当。

oneLineCore.zh: 冲突常在租金和能源，不一定在瓦当。
oneLineCore.en: The clash is often rent and energy, not always the roof-tile.

memoryPoints.zh: 琉璃瓦和玻璃楼抢同一条天际线。
memoryPoints.en: Glazed tiles and glass towers compete for one skyline.

memoryPoints.zh: 传统可以留形式，也可以留人的居住权。
memoryPoints.en: Tradition can keep a form, or keep people’s right to stay.

memoryPoints.zh: 全球化让符号走得更快，解释权也会外流。
memoryPoints.en: Globalization moves symbols faster, and can export the right to explain.

memoryPoints.zh: 哪些该留、哪些可改，要说出谁付钱、谁搬走。
memoryPoints.en: What to keep or change should name who pays and who is moved.

memoryPoints.zh: 平衡不是一句审美，是一套分配。
memoryPoints.en: Balance is not a look; it is a distribution.

imageEvidence.zh: 近景是古建筑的琉璃瓦，黄或绿，曲线和瓦当清楚可数。
imageEvidence.en: Close: glazed tiles of an old building, yellow or green; curves and tile-ends you can count.

imageEvidence.zh: 屋脊上的兽或吻，传统的天际线先占领画面下半。
imageEvidence.en: Beasts or ridge ornaments: the traditional skyline takes the lower half of the frame first.

imageEvidence.zh: 远处一座白塔或传统塔，把「故」再钉一次。
imageEvidence.en: A white pagoda or traditional tower in the distance nails “the old” a second time.

imageEvidence.zh: 更远是深色玻璃写字楼，方、直、反光，和瓦的曲线抢同一片天。
imageEvidence.en: Farther: a dark glass office tower, square, straight, reflective, fighting the tile’s curve for the same sky.

essentialLanguage.collocation: 传统该继续长，还是进博物馆，要分开说。
essentialLanguage.collocationEn: Say separately which tradition should keep growing, and which belongs in a museu

essentialLanguage.collocation: 现代如果不能住，就只是布景。
essentialLanguage.collocationEn: If the modern cannot be lived in, it is only a set.

essentialLanguage.collocation: 全球化换的是菜单，不是国家。
essentialLanguage.collocationEn: Globalization changes the menu, not the country.

essentialLanguage.collocation: 平衡不是各一半。
essentialLanguage.collocationEn: Balance is not fifty-fifty.

essentialLanguage.collocation: 冲突比「融合得很好」更好写。
essentialLanguage.collocationEn: Conflict writes better than “they blend well”.

expressionCaution.zh: 不要把「传统与现代」说成只能选一边。
expressionCaution.en: Do not treat tradition and the modern as a forced either-or.
